title: InstructTTS-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Objective Instruction-Following TTS
abstract: arXiv:2611.33937v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Instruction-following text-to-speech (Instruct-TTS) renders a target transcript in the manner described by a free-form natural-language instruction, and a good rendition must succeed on three fronts at once: following the instruction, pronouncing the transcript correctly, and sounding natural. Reinforcement learning has become the standard way to post-train such generative models toward human preferences, and TTS systems increasingly adopt it. When the three objectives are optimized together under a single scalar reward, typically with group relative policy optimization (GRPO), training tends to be unstable: the objectives compete, and the shared update drifts toward whichever one is easiest to improve, producing a seesaw among them. We instead adapt on-policy distillation (OPD), which fuses several single-objective teachers by matching their velocity fields on the student's own rollouts. translated_title: InstructTTS-OPD：面向多目标指令跟随文本转语音的在策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 指令跟随文本转语音根据自由形式的自然语言指令，以指令所描述的方式合成目标文本，而一个良好的合成结果必须同时在三个方面取得成功：遵循指令、正确发音以及听起来自然。强化学习已成为将此类生成模型进行后训练以对齐人类偏好的标准方法，TTS 系统也越来越多地采用它。当这三个目标在单一标量奖励下联合优化时（通常使用组相对策略优化 GRPO），训练往往不稳定：各目标相互竞争，共享的更新会向最容易改进的目标漂移，从而在它们之间产生跷跷板效应。我们转而采用在策略蒸馏（OPD），通过在学生模型自身的采样结果上匹配多个单目标教师模型的速度场，将它们融合起来。为实现面向 Instruct-TTS 的这一方法，首先需要……
tldr: 该论文提出 InstructTTS-OPD，用在策略蒸馏融合多个单目标教师模型，取代单一标量奖励的强化学习，从而解决指令跟随 TTS 中多目标联合优化带来的训练不稳定与目标间跷跷板效应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes InstructTTS-OPD, which replaces single-scalar-reward reinforcement learning with on-policy distillation that fuses multiple single-objective teachers by matching their velocity fields on the student's own rollouts, resolving the training instability and seesaw effect among competing objectives in multi-objective instruction-following TTS.
